items.text: Adults 21 and over may possess up to 2.5 ounces of cannabis or 1/4 ounce of concentrate (limit raised from 1 ounce on 1 January 2024), bought only from state-licensed stores with photo ID. No use in any public place or a moving vehicle (even as a passenger); private property if the owner allows, or a licensed consumption lounge.

laws.rule: Adults 21 and over may possess up to 2.5 ounces of cannabis or a quarter ounce of concentrate (NRS 678D.200) and buy only from state-licensed stores with ID. Using cannabis in any public place or in a moving vehicle (even as a passenger) is illegal; use is allowed on private property unless the owner prohibits it, or at a licensed consumption lounge. Cannabis remains illegal under US federal law, including on federal land such as national parks.
